cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Grandad's embarrassed about the gazebo. Tell people the garden's unavailable and we're celebrating indoors. Keep it short, the way I taught you for family speeches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's already told Aunt Jean he set it on fire.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say, 'Everyone's fine; we're celebrating indoors.' Good, you checked what she knows before giving her another version.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She wants him to explain the fire in his birthday speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give him that same opening, then cue him to thank her for the trifle. You used to need me to steer you past a bad first story; do that for him.
